_comment: Hand-authored, action-first feature tips for KiroCrew-native features (keyboard shortcuts, Settings toggles, config keys) that have no docs/*.md entry and so can never surface through the doc-scan catalog. Each tip's body ends with the exact thing to do. An optional 'action' object ({kind:'route', label, route}) renders a one-click button that navigates to the exact settings page/control; tips whose feature has no navigable destination (a keyboard shortcut or a mid-turn composer control) omit 'action' and render body only. Loaded by kiro_crew.tips._load_curated_tips; the seven string fields are validated like generated tips, and 'action' is validated separately by _sanitize_tip_action (kind must be 'route'; route must be an internal path).

tips.title: Work two sessions side by side
tips.body: Run two chats at once. Turn on **Settings › Chat › Split View**, then press **⌘D** (**Ctrl+D**) to split the focused pane. Off by default.

tips.title: Jump anywhere with ⌘K
tips.body: Press **⌘K** (**Ctrl+K**), or double-tap **Shift**, to open Search Everywhere — sessions, pages, skills, prompts, artifacts, settings, and runnable actions in one box.

tips.title: Steer a running turn
tips.body: While the agent is working, open the send button's **▾** menu: **Steer** injects your message into the live turn right away; **Queue** runs it after the current turn finishes.

tips.title: Switch to CLI-style output
tips.body: Prefer terminal-style, line-by-line output over chat bubbles? Set **Settings › Display › Interface → CLI**. Applies to this browser.

tips.title: Cut session startup time
tips.body: Pre-spawn agent processes so new sessions start instantly instead of cold-starting. Enable with `kirocrew config set session.pool_size 2`. Off (0) by default.

tips.title: Use less memory with the MCP gateway
tips.body: Route MCP tools through one shared broker instead of a copy per session to cut RAM. Enable the **Shared MCP gateway** toggle (Developer › MCP Pool — requires Developer Mode), or run `kirocrew config set mcp_gateway.enabled true`.

tips.title: Tune how many subagents run at once
tips.body: `agent.max_subagents` caps concurrent subagents. **0 = auto-size** to your machine's memory and CPU; pin a number with `kirocrew config set agent.max_subagents 4`.

tips.title: See local OpenTelemetry metrics
tips.body: Run `kirocrew config set telemetry.enabled true` to record OpenTelemetry metrics under `~/.kirocrew/metrics`, viewable in the Telemetry panel. Stays on your machine — nothing is exported.

tips.title: Run crons with no LLM
tips.body: A scheduled job can run a shell `command` or a Python `script` directly — no model, zero tokens. Ideal for polling, cleanup, and health checks.

tips.title: Manage worktrees and pods from the dashboard
tips.body: Building KiroCrew itself? Enable the **Dev Fleet** app under **Apps → Installed → Show**, then open **Dev Fleet** to manage git worktrees and isolated test pods.

tips.title: Add capabilities from the App Store
tips.body: Open **Apps → Browse** and click **Enable** to add an app's agents, skills, and crons in one step.
